text: import argparse import http.client import json import sys from checker import check_url def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="网站巡检与 API 客户端") parser.add_argument("--url", action="append", help="直接检查，可重复指定；只检查自己有权限的目标") parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8094) args = parser.parse_args() if args.url: results = [] code = 0 for url in args.url: result = check_url(url) results.append(result) if result["status"] != "ok": code = 1 print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)) return code connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", args.port, timeout=20) try: body = json.dumps({"ids": ["self"]}).encode("utf-8") connection.request("POST", "/api/checks", body, {"Content-Type": "application/json"}) response = connection.getresponse() data = response.read(65537) if len(data) 65536: raise ValueError("响应过大") value = json.loads(data.decode("utf-8")) print(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)) if response.status != 200: return 1 for result in value["results"]: if result["status"] != "ok": return 1 return 0 except (OSError, ValueError, http.client.HTTPException, KeyError, TypeError) as error: print("调用失败：", error, file=sys.stderr) return 2 finally: connection.close() if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())

text: import argparse import json import threading from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer from urllib.parse import urlsplit from checker import run_checks class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def setup(self): BaseHTTPRequestHandler.setup(self) self.connection.settimeout(5) def log_message(self, message, args): pass def reply(self, status, value): body = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8") self.send_response(status) self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))) self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store") self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) def do_GET(self): path = urlsplit(self.path).path if path == "/api/health": self.reply(200, {"status": "ok"}) elif path == "/api/results": self.server.result_lock.acquire() try: results = list(self.server.results) finally: self.server.result_lock.release() self.reply(200, {"results": results}) else: self.reply(404, {"error": "接口不存在"}) def do_POST(self): if urlsplit(self.path).path != "/api/checks": self.reply(404, {"error": "接口不存在"}) return if self.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";")[0].strip() != "application/json": self.reply(415, {"error": "需要 application/json"}) return if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding"): self.reply(400, {"error": "教学接口不接收分块请求体"}) return lengths = self.headers.get_all("Content-Length", []) try: if len(lengths) != 1: raise ValueError("需要单个 Content-Length") length = int(lengths[0]) if length = 0 or length 4096: self.reply(413, {"error": "请求体必须为 1 到 4096 字节"}) return raw = self.rfile.read(length) if len(raw) != length: raise ValueError("请求体不完整") value = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8")) if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"ids"}: raise ValueError("仅接受 ids 字段") ids = value["ids"] if not isinstance(ids, list) or len(ids) 1 or len(ids) 5: raise ValueError("ids 必须包含 1 到 5 个目标") seen = set() for target_id in ids: if not isinstance(target_id, str) or target_id not in self.server.targets: raise ValueError("目标未在配置中定义") if target_id in seen: raise ValueError("目标不能重复") seen.add(target_id) except (ValueError, UnicodeError, OSError) as error: self.reply(400, {"error": str(error)}) return if not self.server.check_lock.acquire(blocking=False): self.reply(409, {"error": "已有巡检运行，请稍后再试"}) return try: results = run_checks(self.server.targets, ids, self.server.check_timeout) self.server.result_lock.acquire() try: self.server.results = results finally: self.server.result_lock.release() self.reply(200, {"results": results}) finally: self.server.check_lock.release() def create_server(address, targets, timeout=3): server = ThreadingHTTPServer(address, Handler) server.targets = dict(targets) server.results = [] server.result_lock = threading.Lock() server.check_lock = threading.Lock() server.check_timeout = timeout return server def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="本地巡检教学 API") parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8094) args = parser.parse_args() targets = {"self": "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(args.port) + "/api/health"} server = create_server(("127.0.0.1", args.port), targets) print("API: http://127.0.0.1:" + str(args.port), flush=True) try: server.serve_forever() except KeyboardInterrupt: pass finally: server.server_close() if __name__ == "__main__": main()

title: 资产管理 API
text: 资产管理 API 最新阶段（2026-11-09）：管理员已可在网页读取审计，GET /api/audit 对 viewer/operator 返回 403。真实 Nginx/TLS 临时实验已通过，详见[阶段验证记录](../../代理TLS与综合项目验证-2026-11-09.md)。下文 2026-11-08 的“未验证 TLS”是此前阶段状态；系统服务安装、真实域名和证书续期仍未验证。 Linux 安装有 Nginx、OpenSSL 时，可在本目录运行 python3 check_tls.py --nginx /path/to/nginx 。脚本使用临时 CA、证书、数据库和回环端口，读取实际代理模板验证登录、写入、任务、Cookie、证书拒绝与限速；不修改系统信任库或安装服务。综合学习见[第十单元](../../第十单元-综合实战与独立开发.md)。 日期：2026-11-08 背景：第五单元的结果放在内存；这里用 SQLite 保存资产，逐步加入真实网页和巡检队列。课程见 [第六单元](../../第六单元-数据库与资产管理后端.md)、[第七单元](../../第七单元-前端与Node交互.md) 与 [第八单元](../../第八单元-运维任务队列与执行.md)。 启动 在本目录使用带 sqlite3 的 Python 3： text python check_project.py python server.py --db assets.sqlite3 --port 8095 输出 8095 表示已经监听本机端口。另开终端执行以下完整 Python 示例（保存为 client_practice.py）： python import http.client import json connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", 8095, timeout=5) try: asset = {"name": "web01", "host": "127.0.0.1", "port": 80, "environment": "test"} body = json.dumps(asset).encode("utf-8") connection.request("POST", "/api/assets", body, {"Content-Type": "application/json"}) response = connection.getresponse() print(response.status) print(response.read().decode("utf-8")) finally: connection.close() 第一次创建应是 201；再次创建同名应是 409。浏览器访问 http://127.0.0.1:8095/api/assets 查看列表。Ctrl+C 停止，再以同一路径启动，数据应保留。 阅读入口与接口 - storage.py：字段验证、建表、参数绑定、事务和审计。 - server.py：HTTP 解析、路由、错误码。 - check_project.py：临时数据库和真实 HTTP 验证，不使用你的 assets.sqlite3。 - web/index.html、style.css、app.js：页面结构、样式与回调交互。 - node_client.cjs：独立 Node 查询客户端，不参与网页运行。 - check_browser.cjs：可选浏览器验证，不属于入门第一遍必读代码。 GET /api/assets 支持 limit（1—100）和 offset（0—1000000）。POST /api/assets 接收 name、host、port、environment 四字段。GET、PUT、DELETE /api/assets/编号 分别查询、完整更新和删除。PUT 与 POST 使用同一字段结构。错误格式为 {"error":"原因"} 。课程包含完整响应码表。 登记 host 只保存文本，不自动执行网络访问；第八单元新增显式提交的 TCP 检查。审计与资产变更一起提交；删除资产保留审计。所有 SQL 值使用参数绑定。 验证结果与限制 2026-11-08，WSL Python 隔离验证通过：新增、同名冲突、更新、删除、不存在、分页、非法字段、非法 JSON、内容类型、超长消息、SQL 特殊文本、审计失败回滚、写锁返回 503、重建服务读取旧数据、审计保留。 第六单元重建服务测试在同一进程进行；第九单元另增实际进程生命周期检查，仍未声称测试断电。数据库忙不自动重试；后写覆盖先写，没有版本冲突保护。基础入口 server.py 不带登录；身份、部署和恢复入口见下方第九单元。尚无完整迁移管理。来源见课程末尾。 网页与 Node 客户端 启动 Python 后访问 http://127.0.0.1:8095/ 。页面可新增、编辑、确认删除和分页；断网后保留错误提示，恢复服务后点击刷新。不要双击打开 web/index.html，接口需要同源服务器。 另开终端执行 node node_client.cjs 8095 ，输出总资产数与前五条。Node 只读接口；关闭 Node 不影响网页。运行页面与 Node 客户端都无需第三方包。 可选自动浏览器验证需要本机 Node、Python 和 Playwright。在独立测试环境安装依赖： text npm install --no-save --package-lock=false playwright npx playwright install chromium node check_browser.cjs 如果 Python 不在 PATH，可在 PowerShell 设置 $env:COURSE_PYTHON = '你的 python.exe 完整路径' ；Linux 使用 COURSE_PYTHON=python3 node check_browser.cjs 。脚本自动启动随机本机端口、创建临时数据库、测试后停止自身服务。临时目录保留数据库与截图供排错，不应加入 Git；本课程项目已忽略 node_modules 和包管理生成文件。 2026-11-08：Windows Python 3.14、Node 26、Chromium 实测通过页面 CRUD、重载、409 保留输入、用户文本按文本显示、删除确认、分页、末页回退、离线恢复、390 像素手机宽度和 Node 读取；桌面与手机截图已检查。第七单元独立 HTML 示例与三个 JavaScript 示例也通过。尚未覆盖其他浏览器或生产并发。 第八单元：真实任务执行 新增 jobs.py（持久队列、领取与状态审计）、task_worker.py（固定只读任务）、check_jobs.py（隔离验证）。服务启动后自动启动两个工作线程，最多接收 20 个等待或运行任务。 text python check_jobs.py 网页任务区可提交“平台本机磁盘容量”，或填写已经登记的 IPv4 资产编号做 TCP 检查。平台本机磁盘并非远程资产磁盘。提交返回 202，随后查询任务才知道成功、失败或超时。页面轮询当前选中的任务，终态停止；网络错误后可刷新。 接口 输入或用途 --- --- GET /api/tasks 可用任务白名单 POST /api/jobs {"task":"disk_usage","asset_id":null} 或 {"task":"tcp_connect","asset_id":1} GET /api/jobs 最近 20 条任务 GET /api/jobs/1 状态、输入快照、结果与事件 状态为 queued、running、succeeded、failed、timed_out。历史任务不支持通过接口修改或删除。TCP 子进程连接等待 2 秒，外层子进程执行限时 3 秒；队列满返回 429。仅支持已登记 IPv4，不接受任意命令或脚本路径。 同一个数据库只能启动一个任务引擎，依靠操作系统文件锁实现。正常关闭会等当前有限时长检查结束；重启将遗留 running 标成结果未知的 failed，保留 queued。不要在运行中删除锁文件或用数据库硬链接启动第二个实例。 2026-11-08：Windows 与 WSL Linux 的 check_jobs.py 均通过，包含三个独立课程示例、真实 TCP 成功与拒绝、本机磁盘、白名单拒绝、状态事件、容量、单引擎锁、恢复、真实子进程超时和两线程并发。恢复使用预置状态后重建引擎，并发使用受控执行器；不宣称断电或进程树故障已经验证。浏览器真实提交磁盘与 TCP 任务、轮询结果和错误提示通过，已检查桌面及手机截图。 未决项：生产运行仍需后续评审；备份恢复已在第九单元补充。结果保存失败可能留下 running，需核对后恢复；尚无心跳租约、自动重派和历史保留策略。不要将学习版直接开放到公网。 第九单元：带登录的入口 [登录权限课程](../../第九单元-登录权限与部署.md)的身份部分已完成，[部署备份补充课](../../第九单元补充-部署备份与恢复.md)提供操作手册、模板和恢复工具。使用新入口 secure_server.py，不要把基础课程的 server.py 当作带身份验证的服务。 text python auth.py --db secure.sqlite3 --username myadmin --role admin python secure_server.py --db secure.sqlite3 --port 8096 第一条交互输入密码，重复同一用户名会重置密码/角色并撤销旧会话。第二条启动后访问 http://127.0.0.1:8096/ 。用户创建与启动必须指向同一数据库。无默认账户、无公开注册；不要把密码作为命令行参数或提交进 Git。 viewer 可读；operator 可读和提交任务；admin 可维护资产。所有角色可读全部资产与任务，本项目尚未实现资源级隔离。浏览器显示的角色不是授权依据，实际授权在服务端。 Auth 使用随机盐和 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256，sessions 仅存随机令牌摘要；会话固定一小时，每用户一个有效会话。POST /api/login 要求 JSON、配置 Origin 和 X-Requested-With: ops-course；GET /api/me 返回身份及 CSRF；后续写请求要求相同 Origin 与 X-CSRF-Token；POST /api/logout 撤销会话。Host 与配置公开地址严格匹配。Cookie 有 HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict；HTTPS origin 才加 Secure。当前未验证真实 TLS。 资产审计增加 actor，任务增加 submitted_by。旧记录迁移为 legacy-unknown；本机无身份课程写入标记 local-course。登录等事件存 auth_events。尚无完整审计浏览页面。 text python check_auth.py PowerShell 可设置 $env:COURSE_AUTH_TEST = '1' 再运行 node check_browser.cjs ，验证后用 Remove-Item Env:COURSE_AUTH_TEST 恢复基础模式。测试自行创建临时账户，不接触实际密码。旧 Node 只读客户端未添加认证，访问安全入口收到 HTTP 401 是预期结果。 2026-11-08：身份测试在 Windows 与 WSL Linux 通过；浏览器完成登录、CRUD、任务结果和退出；无登录模式回归通过。密码教学示例已运行。代理/TLS 实际运行未验证，详见课程建设清单。 部署、备份和恢复入口 deploy/ 提供 systemd 单位、非秘密配置示例与 Nginx HTTPS 代理模板。具体目录准备、权限、启动/停止、日志、升级/回退和证书注意事项见部署补充课。模板不是安装脚本；本次未修改系统服务。 text python backup.py backup --source secure.sqlite3 --destination snapshot.sqlite3 python backup.py restore --source snapshot.sqlite3 --destination recovered.sqlite3 python secure_server.py --db recovered.sqlite3 --port 8098 备份使用 SQLite 在线接口，目标必须是新文件。恢复撤销会话，并把未完成任务标记失败而非重放。恢复后重新登录核对数据，再考虑停机切换；不要覆盖运行中的数据库。Windows 检查目录 ACL，Linux 备份默认仅所有者读写。备份可能包含敏感数据，不加入 Git。 python check_backup.py 验证 WAL 已提交快照、恢复后的 HTTP 登录/数据、会话撤销、不重放任务、防覆盖、损坏源等。 python3 check_lifecycle.py 在 Linux 验证真实进程 SIGTERM 收尾、退出码、重启数据和会话保留、日志不含测试秘密。安全入口现在输出简洁请求事件到标准错误，便于 journalctl 查看。 2026-11-08：Windows/Linux 恢复演练通过；Linux 生命周期通过；systemd-analyze verify 返回 0，WSL 挂载文件权限警告已在手册说明。当前没有 Nginx，所以 Nginx/TLS 运行未验证，也未安装 systemd 服务或修改全局信任库。

title: auth.py
text: import argparse import getpass import hashlib import hmac import re import secrets import time from storage import DomainError, Store ROUNDS = 600000 def password_digest(password, salt, rounds): return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), bytes.fromhex(salt), rounds).hex() def token_digest(token): return hashlib.sha256(token.encode("ascii")).hexdigest() class Auth: def __init__(self, store): self.store = store connection = store.connect() try: connection.executescript(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( username TEXT PRIMARY KEY, salt TEXT NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, rounds INTEGER NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('viewer','operator','admin')) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions ( token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL, csrf TEXT NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_attempts ( username TEXT PRIMARY KEY, count INTEGER NOT NULL, reset_at REAL NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_events ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); """) finally: connection.close() def set_user(self, username, password, role): if not isinstance(username, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}", username) is None: raise ValueError("用户名需为 1—40 位字母、数字、下划线或连字符") if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) 12 or len(password) 128: raise ValueError("密码需为 12—128 个字符") if role not in ["viewer", "operator", "admin"]: raise ValueError("未知角色") salt = secrets.token_hex(16) digest = password_digest(password, salt, ROUNDS) connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") connection.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES(?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(username) DO UPDATE SET salt=excluded.salt,password_hash=excluded.password_hash,rounds=excluded.rounds,role=excluded.role", (username, salt, digest, ROUNDS, role)) connection.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE username=?", (username,)) connection.execute("DELETE FROM login_attempts WHERE username=?", (username,)) connection.execute("INSERT INTO auth_events(username,action) VALUES(?,'local_account_update')", (username,)) connection.commit() except Exception: connection.rollback() raise finally: connection.close() def login(self, value): if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"username", "password"}: raise DomainError(400, "需要 username 与 password") username = value["username"] password = value["password"] if not isinstance(username, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}", username) is None: raise DomainError(400, "用户名格式无效") if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) 128: raise DomainError(400, "密码格式无效") now = time.time() connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") connection.execute("DELETE FROM login_attempts WHERE reset_at = ?", (now,)) connection.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires = ?", (now,)) attempt = connection.execute("SELECT count FROM login_attempts WHERE username=?", (username,)).fetchone() if attempt is not None and attempt["count"] = 5: raise DomainError(429, "该用户名尝试过于频繁，请一分钟后重试") connection.execute("INSERT INTO login_attempts VALUES(?,1,?) ON CONFLICT(username) DO UPDATE SET count=count+1", (username, now + 60)) user = connection.execute("SELECT FROM users WHERE username=?", (username,)).fetchone() connection.commit() salt = "00" 16 rounds = ROUNDS expected = "00" 32 if user is not None: salt, rounds, expected = user["salt"], user["rounds"], user["password_hash"] valid = hmac.compare_digest(password_digest(password, salt, rounds), expected) if not valid or user is None: connection.execute("INSERT INTO auth_events(username,action) VALUES(?,'login_failed')", (username,)) raise DomainError(401, "用户名或密码错误") token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32) csrf = secrets.token_urlsafe(32) connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") current = connection.execute("SELECT FROM users WHERE username=?", (username,)).fetchone() if current is None or current["password_hash"] != expected or current["role"] != user["role"]: raise DomainError(401, "账户已变化，请重新登录") connection.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE username=?", (username,)) connection.execute("INSERT INTO sessions VALUES(?,?,?,?)", (token_digest(token), username, csrf, now + 3600)) connection.execute("INSERT INTO auth_events(username,action) VALUES(?,'login_success')", (username,)) connection.commit() return token, {"username": username, "role": user["role"], "csrf": csrf} except Exception: connection.rollback() raise finally: connection.close() def session(self, token): if not isinstance(token, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}", token) is None: raise DomainError(401, "请先登录") connection = self.store.connect() try: row = connection.execute("SELECT users.username,users.role,sessions.csrf FROM sessions JOIN users USING(username) WHERE token_hash=? AND expires ?", (token_digest(token), time.time())).fetchone() if row is None: raise DomainError(401, "会话已失效，请重新登录") return dict(row) finally: connection.close() def logout(self, token, username): connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") connection.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token_hash=?", (token_digest(token),)) connection.execute("INSERT INTO auth_events(username,action) VALUES(?,'logout')", (username,)) connection.commit() except Exception: connection.rollback() raise finally: connection.close() def audit(self): connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN") result = {"assets": [], "accounts": [], "jobs": []} for row in connection.execute("SELECT id,action,asset_id,actor,created_at FROM audit ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"): result["assets"].append(dict(row)) for row in connection.execute("SELECT id,username,action,created_at FROM auth_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"): result["accounts"].append(dict(row)) for row in connection.execute("SELECT id,task,state,submitted_by,created_at FROM jobs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"): result["jobs"].append(dict(row)) connection.commit() return result finally: connection.close() def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="本机创建/重置账户，撤销该用户已有会话") parser.add_argument("--db", required=True) parser.add_argument("--username", required=True) parser.add_argument("--role", choices=["viewer", "operator", "admin"], required=True) args = parser.parse_args() password = getpass.getpass("密码（12—128 字符）：") if password != getpass.getpass("再次输入："): raise SystemExit("两次密码不一致") Auth(Store(args.db)).set_user(args.username, password, args.role) print("账户已保存，旧会话已撤销。") if __name__ == "__main__": main()

title: backup.py
text: """备份安全入口数据库；恢复始终创建新文件，绝不覆盖现用数据库。""" import argparse import json import os from pathlib import Path import sqlite3 import time TABLES = ["assets", "audit", "jobs", "job_events", "users", "sessions", "login_attempts", "auth_events"] def validate(connection): if connection.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchall() != [("ok",)]: raise ValueError("数据库完整性检查失败") names = [] for row in connection.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"): names.append(row[0]) for name in TABLES: if name not in names: raise ValueError("缺少安全平台数据表：" + name) def copy_database(source, destination, restore=False, timeout=20): source = Path(source).resolve(strict=True) destination = Path(destination).absolute() if not source.is_file(): raise ValueError("源文件不是普通文件") if source == destination.resolve(): raise ValueError("源与目标不能相同") source_connection = sqlite3.connect(source.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=2) target_connection = None created = False finished = False deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout def progress(status, remaining, total): if time.monotonic() deadline: raise TimeoutError("备份等待超过时限") try: validate(source_connection) 排他创建：即使目标是已有符号链接，也不会覆盖它。 descriptor = os.open(destination, os.O_CREAT os.O_EXCL os.O_WRONLY, 0o600) os.close(descriptor) created = True target_connection = sqlite3.connect(destination) source_connection.backup(target_connection, pages=64, progress=progress, sleep=0.05) validate(target_connection) if restore: target_connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") target_connection.execute("DELETE FROM sessions") target_connection.execute("DELETE FROM login_attempts") target_connection.execute("INSERT INTO job_events(job_id,state) SELECT id,'failed' FROM jobs WHERE state IN ('queued','running')") target_connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='failed',result_json=?,finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE state IN ('queued','running')", (json.dumps({"error": "从备份恢复：未完成任务不自动重放，请核对后重新提交"}, ensure_ascii=False),)) target_connection.execute("INSERT INTO auth_events(username,action) VALUES('system','restore_revoke_sessions')") target_connection.commit() validate(target_connection) result = {"destination": str(destination), "restored": restore, "assets": target_connection.execute("SELECT COUNT( ) FROM assets").fetchone()[0], "jobs": target_connection.execute("SELECT COUNT( ) FROM jobs").fetchone()[0]} finished = True return result finally: if target_connection is not None: target_connection.close() source_connection.close() if created and not finished: destination.unlink() def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="安全平台 SQLite 在线备份 / 恢复到新文件") parser.add_argument("action", choices=["backup", "restore"]) parser.add_argument("--source", required=True) parser.add_argument("--destination", required=True) args = parser.parse_args() try: result = copy_database(args.source, args.destination, args.action == "restore") except (OSError, sqlite3.Error, ValueError) as error: print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": str(error)}, ensure_ascii=False)) raise SystemExit(1) print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "result": result}, ensure_ascii=False)) if __name__ == "__main__": main()

", lesson.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), re.S) assert len(examples) == 1 result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", examples[0]], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5) assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip() == "True" directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() path = os.path.join(directory.name, "auth.sqlite3") store = Store(path) auth = Auth(store) password = secrets.token_urlsafe(24) for role in ["viewer", "operator", "admin"]: auth.set_user(role, password, role) server = create_secure_server(("127.0.0.1", 0), path) thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever) thread.start() origin = server.origin def request(method, path, value=None, cookie="", csrf="", extra=None): headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Origin": origin, "X-Requested-With": "ops-course", "Cookie": cookie, "X-CSRF-Token": csrf} if extra is not None: headers.update(extra) body = None if value is not None: body = json.dumps(value).encode("utf-8") connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", server.server_port, timeout=5) try: connection.request(method, path, body, headers) response = connection.getresponse() data = response.read().decode("utf-8") return response.status, json.loads(data), response.getheader("Set-Cookie") finally: connection.close() def login(username): status, user, cookie = request("POST", "/api/login", {"username": username, "password": password}) assert status == 200 assert "HttpOnly" in cookie and "SameSite=Strict" in cookie return cookie.split(";")[0], user["csrf"] try: assert request("GET", "/api/assets")[0] == 401 assert request("GET", "/api/jobs")[0] == 401 assert request("GET", "/api/assets", extra={"Host": "attacker.invalid"})[0] == 400 credentials = {"username": "admin", "password": password} assert request("POST", "/api/login", credentials, extra={"Origin": "http://evil.invalid"})[0] == 403 assert request("POST", "/api/login", credentials, extra={"X-Requested-With": ""})[0] == 403 asset = {"name": "auth-test", "host": "127.0.0.1", "port": 80, "environment": "test"} viewer, viewer_csrf = login("viewer") assert request("GET", "/api/audit", cookie=viewer)[0] == 403 assert request("GET", "/api/assets", cookie=viewer)[0] == 200 assert request("POST", "/api/assets", asset, viewer, viewer_csrf)[0] == 403 assert request("POST", "/api/jobs", {"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None}, viewer, viewer_csrf)[0] == 403 operator, operator_csrf = login("operator") assert request("GET", "/api/audit", cookie=operator)[0] == 403 assert request("POST", "/api/assets", asset, operator, operator_csrf)[0] == 403 status, job, unused = request("POST", "/api/jobs", {"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None}, operator, operator_csrf) assert status == 202 and job["submitted_by"] == "operator" admin, csrf = login("admin") assert request("POST", "/api/assets", asset, admin)[0] == 403 assert request("POST", "/api/assets", asset, admin, viewer_csrf)[0] == 403 assert request("POST", "/api/assets", asset, admin, csrf, {"Origin": "null"})[0] == 403 status, item, unused = request("POST", "/api/assets", asset, admin, csrf) assert status == 201 audit_status, audit_data, unused = request("GET", "/api/audit", cookie=admin) assert audit_status == 200 and audit_data["assets"][0]["actor"] == "admin" audit_text = json.dumps(audit_data) for secret in [password, csrf, admin.split("=", 1)[1], "password_hash", "salt", "token_hash"]: assert secret not in audit_text connection = store.connect() try: assert connection.execute("SELECT actor FROM audit WHERE asset_id=?", (item["id"],)).fetchone()[0] == "admin" raw = connection.execute("SELECT password_hash,salt FROM users WHERE username='admin'").fetchone() assert raw["password_hash"] != password and len(raw["salt"]) == 32 assert connection.execute("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT password_hash) FROM users").fetchone()[0] == 3 token = admin.split("=", 1)[1] assert connection.execute("SELECT token_hash FROM sessions WHERE username='admin'").fetchone()[0] == token_digest(token) finally: connection.close() status, unused, deleted = request("POST", "/api/logout", {}, admin, csrf) assert status == 200 and "Max-Age=0" in deleted assert request("GET", "/api/me", cookie=admin)[0] == 401 admin, csrf = login("admin") new_admin, new_csrf = login("admin") assert request("GET", "/api/me", cookie=admin)[0] == 401 auth.set_user("admin", password, "viewer") assert request("GET", "/api/me", cookie=new_admin)[0] == 401 connection = store.connect() try: connection.execute("UPDATE sessions SET expires=? WHERE username='viewer'", (time.time() - 1,)) finally: connection.close() assert request("GET", "/api/me", cookie=viewer)[0] == 401 for number in range(5): assert request("POST", "/api/login", {"username": "missing", "password": "wrong"})[0] == 401 assert request("POST", "/api/login", {"username": "missing", "password": "wrong"})[0] == 429 print("PASS: authentication, role matrix, origin/Host, CSRF, cookie flags, salts, hashed sessions, audit actor, logout, rotation, expiry, reset revocation, throttling") finally: server.shutdown() server.server_close() thread.join() directory.cleanup() if __name__ == "__main__": main()

text: import http.client import json import os from pathlib import Path import secrets import sqlite3 import subprocess import sys import tempfile import threading from auth import Auth from backup import copy_database from jobs import JobEngine from secure_server import create_secure_server from storage import Store def main(): directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() root = Path(directory.name) source = root / "live.sqlite3" snapshot = root / "snapshot.sqlite3" restored = root / "restored.sqlite3" store = Store(source) auth = Auth(store) password = secrets.token_urlsafe(24) auth.set_user("restore_admin", password, "admin") old_token, unused = auth.login({"username": "restore_admin", "password": password}) store.write("create", value={"name": "before-backup", "host": "127.0.0.1", "port": 80, "environment": "test"}, actor="restore_admin") engine = JobEngine(store, workers=0) connection = store.connect() try: engine.submit({"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None}, "restore_admin") engine.claim() engine.submit({"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None}, "restore_admin") connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL") connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") connection.execute("UPDATE assets SET name='uncommitted'") result = copy_database(source, snapshot) assert result["assets"] == 1 and result["jobs"] == 2 connection.rollback() assert connection.execute("SELECT COUNT( ) FROM sessions").fetchone()[0] == 1 store.write("update", 1, {"name": "after-backup", "host": "127.0.0.1", "port": 80, "environment": "test"}) copy_database(snapshot, restored, restore=True) target = sqlite3.connect(restored) try: assert target.execute("SELECT name FROM assets").fetchone()[0] == "before-backup" assert target.execute("SELECT COUNT( ) FROM sessions").fetchone()[0] == 0 assert target.execute("SELECT COUNT( ) FROM jobs WHERE state='failed'").fetchone()[0] == 2 assert target.execute("SELECT COUNT( ) FROM job_events WHERE state='failed'").fetchone()[0] == 2 finally: target.close() before = snapshot.read_bytes() try: copy_database(source, snapshot) except FileExistsError: pass else: raise AssertionError("不应覆盖已有备份") assert snapshot.read_bytes() == before for invalid in [root / "missing.sqlite3", root / "broken.sqlite3"]: if invalid.name == "broken.sqlite3": invalid.write_text("not a database", encoding="utf-8") output = root / "invalid-output.sqlite3" process = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name("backup.py")), "restore", "--source", str(invalid), "--destination", str(output)], capture_output=True, timeout=10) assert process.returncode == 1 and not output.exists() try: copy_database(source, source) except ValueError: pass else: raise AssertionError("源目标相同应拒绝") if os.name != "nt": assert snapshot.stat().st_mode & 0o077 == 0 finally: connection.close() engine.close() server = create_secure_server(("127.0.0.1", 0), restored) thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever) thread.start() def request(method, path, data=None, cookie=""): headers = {"Cookie": cookie, "Origin": server.origin, "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Requested-With": "ops-course"} body = None if data is not None: body = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8") client = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", server.server_port, timeout=5) try: client.request(method, path, body, headers) response = client.getresponse() return response.status, json.loads(response.read()), response.getheader("Set-Cookie") finally: client.close() try: assert request("GET", "/api/assets", cookie="ops_session=" + old_token)[0] == 401 status, user, cookie = request("POST", "/api/login", {"username": "restore_admin", "password": password}) assert status == 200 status, assets, unused = request("GET", "/api/assets", cookie=cookie.split(";")[0]) assert status == 200 and assets["items"][0]["name"] == "before-backup" assert request("GET", "/api/jobs", cookie=cookie.split(";")[0])[1]["items"][0]["state"] == "failed" print("PASS: online WAL snapshot, restore login/data, session revocation, no queued replay, no overwrite, missing/corrupt source, same path, POSIX permissions") finally: server.shutdown() server.server_close() thread.join() directory.cleanup() if __name__ == "__main__": main()

import json import os import re import socket import subprocess import sys import tempfile import threading import time from pathlib import Path from check_project import request, start, stop from jobs import JobEngine, run_command from storage import DomainError, Store def await_job(port, job_id): deadline = time.monotonic() + 10 while time.monotonic() deadline: status, job = request(port, "GET", "/api/jobs/" + str(job_id)) assert status == 200 if job["state"] not in ["queued", "running"]: return job time.sleep(0.05) raise AssertionError("任务未结束") def expect_error(engine, value, expected): try: engine.submit(value) except DomainError as error: assert error.status == expected else: raise AssertionError("预期拒绝") def main(): lesson = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "第八单元-运维任务队列与执行.md" examples = re.findall(r" python
(. ?) ", lesson.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), re.S) expected = ["队列已满
检查 web01
检查 web02", "主线程准备完成
工作线程开始检查
所有工作结束", "直接子进程已因超时结束"] assert len(examples) == len(expected) for number in range(len(examples)): result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-X", "utf8", "-c", examples[number]], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=5) assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr assert result.stdout.strip() == expected[number] directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() server, thread = start(os.path.join(directory.name, "http.sqlite3")) listener = socket.socket() try: port = server.server_port listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)) listener.listen(5) asset = {"name": "local-listener", "host": "127.0.0.1", "port": listener.getsockname()[1], "environment": "test"} status, asset = request(port, "POST", "/api/assets", asset) assert status == 201 status, job = request(port, "POST", "/api/jobs", {"task": "tcp_connect", "asset_id": asset["id"]}) assert status == 202 done = await_job(port, job["id"]) assert done["state"] == "succeeded" and done["result"]["connected"] is True accepted, address = listener.accept() accepted.close() listener.close() status, failed = request(port, "POST", "/api/jobs", {"task": "tcp_connect", "asset_id": asset["id"]}) assert status == 202 assert await_job(port, failed["id"])["state"] == "failed" status, disk = request(port, "POST", "/api/jobs", {"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None}) assert status == 202 disk = await_job(port, disk["id"]) assert disk["state"] == "succeeded" and disk["result"]["total_bytes"] 0 states = [] for event in disk["events"]: states.append(event["state"]) assert states == ["queued", "running", "succeeded"] for value in [{"task": "shell", "asset_id": None}, {"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None, "command": "whoami"}, {"task": "tcp_connect", "asset_id": True}]: assert request(port, "POST", "/api/jobs", value)[0] == 400 assert request(port, "POST", "/api/jobs", {"task": "tcp_connect", "asset_id": 999999})[0] == 404 assert request(port, "DELETE", "/api/jobs/1")[0] == 405 assert request(port, "GET", "/api/jobs/999999")[0] == 404 finally: listener.close() stop(server, thread) store = Store(os.path.join(directory.name, "queue.sqlite3")) engine = JobEngine(store, workers=0, capacity=2) try: first = engine.submit({"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None}) second = engine.submit({"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None}) assert first["state"] == "queued" expect_error(engine, {"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None}, 429) claimed = engine.claim() assert claimed["id"] == first["id"] try: duplicate = JobEngine(store, workers=0) except OSError: pass else: duplicate.close() raise AssertionError("同一数据库不能有两个任务引擎") finally: engine.close() engine = JobEngine(store, workers=0) try: assert engine.get(first["id"])["state"] == "failed" assert engine.get(second["id"])["state"] == "queued" assert engine.claim()["id"] == second["id"] state, output = run_command([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(5)"], 0.15) assert state == "timed_out" engine.finish(second["id"], state, output) assert engine.get(second["id"])["state"] == "timed_out" finally: engine.close() gate = threading.Event() lock = threading.Lock() seen = [] active = [0, 0] def controlled_executor(job): lock.acquire() try: active[0] = active[0] + 1 active[1] = max(active[0], active[1]) seen.append(job["id"]) finally: lock.release() gate.wait(5) lock.acquire() active[0] = active[0] - 1 lock.release() return "succeeded", {"controlled_test": True} engine = JobEngine(Store(os.path.join(directory.name, "concurrency.sqlite3")), workers=2, executor=controlled_executor) try: ids = [] for number in range(4): ids.append(engine.submit({"task": "disk_usage", "asset_id": None})["id"]) deadline = time.monotonic() + 5 while len(seen) 2 and time.monotonic() deadline: time.sleep(0.02) assert len(seen) == 2 and active[1] == 2 assert engine.get(ids[2])["state"] == "queued" gate.set() deadline = time.monotonic() + 5 while engine.get(ids[3])["state"] != "succeeded" and time.monotonic() deadline: time.sleep(0.02) assert len(seen) == 4 and len(set(seen)) == 4 and active[1] == 2 finally: gate.set() engine.close() directory.cleanup() print("PASS: lesson examples, real TCP/disk, HTTP whitelist, states/audit, capacity, single engine, restart recovery, real subprocess timeout, worker concurrency") if __name__ == "__main__": main()

title: check_lifecycle.py
text: """Linux：验证实际进程启动、SIGTERM 收尾和重启持久化。""" import http.client import json import os from pathlib import Path import queue import secrets import subprocess import sys import tempfile import threading from auth import Auth from storage import Store def main(): if os.name == "nt": raise SystemExit("此检查需要 Linux SIGTERM 语义，请在 WSL/Linux 运行") directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() path = str(Path(directory.name) / "platform.sqlite3") auth = Auth(Store(path)) password = secrets.token_urlsafe(24) auth.set_user("lifecycle", password, "admin") token, user = auth.login({"username": "lifecycle", "password": password}) process = None def start(): child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name("secure_server.py")), "--db", path, "--port", "0"], cwd=directory.name, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True) ready = queue.Queue() def read_ready(): ready.put(child.stdout.readline()) reader = threading.Thread(target=read_ready, daemon=True) reader.start() try: line = ready.get(timeout=10) port = int(line.strip()) except Exception: child.kill() child.communicate(timeout=5) raise return child, port def request(port, method, path, value=None): headers = {"Cookie": "ops_session=" + token, "X-CSRF-Token": user["csrf"], "Origin": "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port), "Content-Type": "application/json"} body = None if value is not None: body = json.dumps(value).encode("utf-8") client = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", port, timeout=5) try: client.request(method, path, body, headers) response = client.getresponse() return response.status, json.loads(response.read()) finally: client.close() try: process, port = start() status, asset = request(port, "POST", "/api/assets", {"name": "survives-restart", "host": "127.0.0.1", "port": 80, "environment": "test"}) assert status == 201 process.terminate() stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=10) assert process.returncode == 0, stderr process, port = start() status, assets = request(port, "GET", "/api/assets") assert status == 200 and assets["items"][0]["id"] == asset["id"] assert assets["items"][0]["name"] == "survives-restart" process.terminate() stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=10) assert process.returncode == 0, stderr assert '"status": 200' in stderr assert password not in stderr and token not in stderr and user["csrf"] not in stderr print("PASS: real process restart, SIGTERM exit 0, persisted assets/sessions, released job lock, credential-free request log") finally: if process is not None and process.poll() is None: process.kill() process.communicate(timeout=5) directory.cleanup() if __name__ == "__main__": main()

title: jobs.py
text: import ipaddress import json import os import sqlite3 import subprocess import sys import threading from pathlib import Path from storage import DomainError TASKS = {"disk_usage": "平台本机磁盘容量", "tcp_connect": "资产 IPv4 TCP 端口连接"} def run_command(command, timeout): try: result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=timeout, shell=False) except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: return "timed_out", {"error": "执行超过时限，子进程已终止"} except OSError: return "failed", {"error": "无法启动检查进程"} try: output = json.loads(result.stdout) except ValueError: return "failed", {"error": "检查进程未返回有效 JSON"} if result.returncode != 0: return "failed", output return "succeeded", output def execute_job(job): command = [sys.executable, "-X", "utf8", str(Path(__file__).with_name("task_worker.py")), job["task"], job["input_json"]] return run_command(command, 3) class JobEngine: def __init__(self, store, workers=2, capacity=20, executor=execute_job): self.store = store self.capacity = capacity self.executor = executor self.stop_event = threading.Event() self.threads = [] self.lock_file = open(str(Path(store.path).resolve()) + ".worker.lock", "a+b") try: self.lock_file.seek(0, os.SEEK_END) if self.lock_file.tell() == 0: self.lock_file.write(b"0") self.lock_file.flush() self.lock_file.seek(0) if os.name == "nt": import msvcrt msvcrt.locking(self.lock_file.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1) else: import fcntl fcntl.flock(self.lock_file.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX fcntl.LOCK_NB) self.initialize() for number in range(workers): thread = threading.Thread(target=self.work, name="ops-worker-" + str(number)) thread.start() self.threads.append(thread) except Exception: self.close() raise def initialize(self): connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.executescript(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, task TEXT NOT NULL, input_json TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','timed_out')), result_json TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, started_at TEXT, finished_at TEXT ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_events ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jobs_state_id ON jobs(state, id); """) columns = [] for column in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(jobs)"): columns.append(column["name"]) if "submitted_by" not in columns: connection.execute("ALTER TABLE jobs ADD COLUMN submitted_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy-unknown'") connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") connection.execute("INSERT INTO job_events(job_id,state) SELECT id,'failed' FROM jobs WHERE state='running'") connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='failed', result_json=?, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE state='running'", (json.dumps({"error": "服务中断，执行结果未知；未自动重试"}, ensure_ascii=False),)) connection.commit() except Exception: connection.rollback() raise finally: connection.close() def submit(self, value, actor="local-course"): if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"task", "asset_id"}: raise DomainError(400, "需要 task 与 asset_id") task = value["task"] if not isinstance(task, str) or task not in TASKS: raise DomainError(400, "任务不在白名单中") if task == "disk_usage" and value["asset_id"] is not None: raise DomainError(400, "本机检查的 asset_id 必须为 null") if task == "tcp_connect" and (type(value["asset_id"]) is not int or value["asset_id"] 1 or value["asset_id"] 10 18): raise DomainError(400, "请选择有效资产编号") connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") count = connection.execute("SELECT COUNT( ) FROM jobs WHERE state IN ('queued','running')").fetchone()[0] if count = self.capacity: raise DomainError(429, "等待与运行中的任务已满，请稍后提交") data = {} if task == "tcp_connect": asset = connection.execute("SELECT FROM assets WHERE id=?", (value["asset_id"],)).fetchone() if asset is None: raise DomainError(404, "资产不存在") try: host = str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(asset["host"])) except ValueError: raise DomainError(400, "本单元 TCP 检查只接受 IPv4 地址，不做域名解析") data = {"asset_id": asset["id"], "name": asset["name"], "host": host, "port": asset["port"]} cursor = connection.execute("INSERT INTO jobs(task,input_json,state,submitted_by) VALUES(?,?,'queued',?)", (task, json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), actor)) job_id = cursor.lastrowid connection.execute("INSERT INTO job_events(job_id,state) VALUES(?,'queued')", (job_id,)) connection.commit() return self.get(job_id) except Exception: connection.rollback() raise finally: connection.close() def get(self, job_id): connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN") row = connection.execute("SELECT FROM jobs WHERE id=?", (job_id,)).fetchone() if row is None: raise DomainError(404, "任务不存在") result = dict(row) result["input"] = json.loads(result.pop("input_json")) raw = result.pop("result_json") result["result"] = None if raw is not None: result["result"] = json.loads(raw) result["events"] = [] for event in connection.execute("SELECT state,created_at FROM job_events WHERE job_id=? ORDER BY id", (job_id,)): result["events"].append(dict(event)) connection.commit() return result finally: connection.close() def recent(self): connection = self.store.connect() try: items = [] for row in connection.execute("SELECT id,task,state,created_at FROM jobs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20"): items.append(dict(row)) return {"items": items} finally: connection.close() def claim(self): connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") row = connection.execute("SELECT FROM jobs WHERE state='queued' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1").fetchone() if row is None: connection.commit() return None connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='running', started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=?", (row["id"],)) connection.execute("INSERT INTO job_events(job_id,state) VALUES(?,'running')", (row["id"],)) connection.commit() return dict(row) except Exception: connection.rollback() raise finally: connection.close() def finish(self, job_id, state, result): if state not in ["succeeded", "failed", "timed_out"]: raise ValueError("未知结束状态") connection = self.store.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") cursor = connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state=?,result_json=?,finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=? AND state='running'", (state, json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), job_id)) if cursor.rowcount != 1: raise ValueError("任务不是运行状态") connection.execute("INSERT INTO job_events(job_id,state) VALUES(?,?)", (job_id, state)) connection.commit() except Exception: connection.rollback() raise finally: connection.close() def work(self): while not self.stop_event.is_set(): try: job = self.claim() if job is not None: try: state, result = self.executor(job) except Exception: state, result = "failed", {"error": "检查执行器发生异常"} self.finish(job["id"], state, result) continue except sqlite3.Error as error: print("任务数据库错误：" + type(error).__name__, file=sys.stderr) self.stop_event.wait(0.2) def close(self): self.stop_event.set() for thread in self.threads: thread.join() self.lock_file.close()

text: """第九单元入口；保留 server.py 供前置单元学习，不用于对外部署。""" import argparse import hmac import sqlite3 import signal import json import sys from http.cookies import SimpleCookie, CookieError from urllib.parse import urlsplit from pathlib import Path from auth import Auth from jobs import JobEngine from server import Handler, AppServer from storage import DomainError, Store class SecureHandler(Handler): def log_request(self, code="-", size="-"): 不记录请求体、查询串、Cookie 或 CSRF。 print(json.dumps({"event": "http", "method": self.command, "status": code, "actor": getattr(self, "actor", "anonymous")}), file=sys.stderr, flush=True) def serve_page(self, path): if self.command != "GET": return False filename = None media = "text/html; charset=utf-8" if path == "/login.js": filename = "login.js" media = "text/javascript; charset=utf-8" if path == "/": try: cookies = SimpleCookie(self.headers.get("Cookie", "")) self.server.auth.session(cookies["ops_session"].value) except (KeyError, CookieError, DomainError): filename = "login.html" if filename is None: return Handler.serve_page(self, path) body = (Path(__file__).parent / "web" / filename).read_bytes() self.send_response(200) self.send_header("Content-Type", media) self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))) self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store") self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'") self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) return True def end_headers(self): cookie = getattr(self, "response_cookie", None) if text: import argparse import json import sqlite3 from pathlib import Path from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit from storage import DomainError, Store from jobs import JobEngine, TASKS class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def serve_page(self, path): files = { "/": ("index.html", "text/html; charset=utf-8"), "/app.js": ("app.js", "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"), "/style.css": ("style.css", "text/css; charset=utf-8") } if path not in files or self.command != "GET": return False filename, media = files[path] body = (Path(__file__).parent / "web" / filename).read_bytes() self.send_response(200) self.send_header("Content-Type", media) self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))) self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store") self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff") self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'") self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) return True def setup(self): BaseHTTPRequestHandler.setup(self) self.connection.settimeout(5) def log_message(self, message, args): pass def reply(self, status, value): body = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8") self.send_response(status) self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))) self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store") self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) def read_json(self): if self.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";")[0].strip() != "application/json": raise DomainError(415, "需要 application/json") lengths = self.headers.get_all("Content-Length", []) if len(lengths) != 1 or self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding"): raise DomainError(400, "需要单个 Content-Length，不接收分块消息") length = int(lengths[0]) if length 1 or length 8192: raise DomainError(413, "请求体必须为 1 到 8192 字节") raw = self.rfile.read(length) if len(raw) != length: raise DomainError(400, "消息体不完整") return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8")) def dispatch(self): try: address = urlsplit(self.path) path = address.path if self.serve_page(path): return store = self.server.store actor = getattr(self, "actor", "local-course") if path == "/api/me" and self.command == "GET": self.reply(200, {"username": "local-course", "role": "admin", "csrf": None}) return if path == "/api/tasks" and self.command == "GET": self.reply(200, {"tasks": TASKS}) return if path == "/api/jobs": if self.command == "GET": self.reply(200, self.server.jobs.recent()) elif self.command == "POST": self.reply(202, self.server.jobs.submit(self.read_json(), actor)) else: raise DomainError(405, "任务列表不支持此方法") return if path.startswith("/api/jobs/"): part = path[len("/api/jobs/"):] if not part.isascii() or not part.isdigit() or len(part) 18: raise DomainError(404, "任务路径不存在") if self.command != "GET": raise DomainError(405, "任务只能查询，不支持修改历史") self.reply(200, self.server.jobs.get(int(part))) return if path == "/api/health" and self.command == "GET": self.reply(200, {"status": "ok"}) return if path == "/api/assets": if self.command == "GET": query = parse_qs(address.query, keep_blank_values=True) for key in query: if key not in ["limit", "offset"] or len(query[key]) != 1: raise DomainError(400, "分页参数未知或重复") limit = int(query.get("limit", ["20"])[0]) offset = int(query.get("offset", ["0"])[0]) if limit 1 or limit 100 or offset 0 or offset 1000000: raise DomainError(400, "分页范围错误") self.reply(200, store.list_assets(limit, offset)) elif self.command == "POST": self.reply(201, store.write("create", value=self.read_json(), actor=actor)) else: raise DomainError(405, "该路径不支持此方法") return if path.startswith("/api/assets/"): part = path[len("/api/assets/"):] if not part.isascii() or not part.isdigit() or len(part) 18: raise DomainError(404, "资产路径不存在") asset_id = int(part) if self.command == "GET": self.reply(200, store.get_asset(asset_id)) elif self.command == "PUT": self.reply(200, store.write("update", asset_id, self.read_json(), actor)) elif self.command == "DELETE": self.reply(200, store.write("delete", asset_id, actor=actor)) else: raise DomainError(405, "该路径不支持此方法") return raise DomainError(404, "接口不存在") except DomainError as error: self.reply(error.status, {"error": str(error)}) except (ValueError, UnicodeError): self.reply(400, {"error": "输入格式无效"}) except sqlite3.IntegrityError: self.reply(409, {"error": "资产名称重复或违反数据约束"}) except sqlite3.OperationalError: self.reply(503, {"error": "数据库暂时不可用"}) except sqlite3.DatabaseError: self.reply(500, {"error": "数据库操作失败"}) except OSError: self.close_connection = True def do_GET(self): self.dispatch() def do_POST(self): self.dispatch() def do_PUT(self): self.dispatch() def do_DELETE(self): self.dispatch() class AppServer(ThreadingHTTPServer): jobs = None def server_close(self): ThreadingHTTPServer.server_close(self) if self.jobs is not None: self.jobs.close() self.jobs = None def create_server(address, db_path): store = Store(db_path) server = AppServer(address, Handler) server.store = store try: server.jobs = JobEngine(store) except Exception: server.server_close() raise return server def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="本地资产 API") parser.add_argument("--db", default="assets.sqlite3") parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8095) args = parser.parse_args() server = create_server(("127.0.0.1", args.port), args.db) print(server.server_port, flush=True) try: server.serve_forever() except KeyboardInterrupt: pass finally: server.server_close() if __name__ == "__main__": main()

text: import sqlite3 class DomainError(Exception): def __init__(self, status, message): Exception.__init__(self, message) self.status = status def validate_asset(value): if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"name", "host", "port", "environment"}: raise DomainError(400, "需要 name、host、port、environment 四个字段") data = {} for key, maximum in [("name", 80), ("host", 253), ("environment", 20)]: item = value[key] if not isinstance(item, str) or not item.strip() or len(item.strip()) maximum: raise DomainError(400, key + " 必须为长度合适的非空文本") data[key] = item.strip() for character in data[key]: if ord(character) 32: raise DomainError(400, "文本不能包含控制字符") port = value["port"] if type(port) is not int or port 1 or port 65535: raise DomainError(400, "port 必须是 1 到 65535 的整数") if data["environment"] not in ["dev", "test", "prod"]: raise DomainError(400, "environment 必须是 dev、test 或 prod") data["port"] = port return data class Store: def __init__(self, path): self.path = path connection = self.connect() try: connection.executescript(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assets ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, host TEXT NOT NULL, port INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment IN ('dev','test','prod')) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, action TEXT NOT NULL, asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); """) columns = [] for column in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(audit)"): columns.append(column["name"]) if "actor" not in columns: connection.execute("ALTER TABLE audit ADD COLUMN actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy-unknown'") finally: connection.close() def connect(self): connection = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=2, isolation_level=None) connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return connection def list_assets(self, limit, offset): connection = self.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN") total = connection.execute("SELECT COUNT( ) FROM assets").fetchone()[0] rows = connection.execute("SELECT FROM assets ORDER BY id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", (limit, offset)).fetchall() items = [] for row in rows: items.append(dict(row)) connection.commit() return {"items": items, "total": total, "limit": limit, "offset": offset} finally: connection.close() def get_asset(self, asset_id): connection = self.connect() try: row = connection.execute("SELECT FROM assets WHERE id = ?", (asset_id,)).fetchone() if row is None: raise DomainError(404, "资产不存在") return dict(row) finally: connection.close() def write(self, action, asset_id=None, value=None, actor="local-course"): if action not in ["create", "update", "delete"]: raise ValueError("Unknown action") data = None if action != "delete": data = validate_asset(value) connection = self.connect() try: connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") if action == "create": cursor = connection.execute("INSERT INTO assets(name,host,port,environment) VALUES(?,?,?,?)", (data["name"], data["host"], data["port"], data["environment"])) asset_id = cursor.lastrowid else: if connection.execute("SELECT id FROM assets WHERE id=?", (asset_id,)).fetchone() is None: raise DomainError(404, "资产不存在") if action == "update": connection.execute("UPDATE assets SET name=?,host=?,port=?,environment=? WHERE id=?", (data["name"], data["host"], data["port"], data["environment"], asset_id)) else: connection.execute("DELETE FROM assets WHERE id=?", (asset_id,)) connection.execute("INSERT INTO audit(action,asset_id,actor) VALUES(?,?,?)", (action, asset_id, actor)) result = {"deleted": asset_id} if action != "delete": result = dict(connection.execute("SELECT FROM assets WHERE id=?", (asset_id,)).fetchone()) connection.commit() return result except Exception: connection.rollback() raise finally: connection.close()

text: """只执行程序内定义的只读检查；不接受命令字符串。""" import ipaddress import json import shutil import socket import sys from pathlib import Path def main(): task = sys.argv[1] value = json.loads(sys.argv[2]) if task == "disk_usage": usage = shutil.disk_usage(Path(__file__).anchor) result = {"total_bytes": usage.total, "used_bytes": usage.used, "free_bytes": usage.free} elif task == "tcp_connect": host = str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(value["host"])) connection = socket.create_connection((host, value["port"]), timeout=2) connection.close() result = {"host": host, "port": value["port"], "connected": True} else: raise ValueError("不支持的任务") print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False)) if __name__ == "__main__": try: main() except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError) as error: print(json.dumps({"error": str(error)}, ensure_ascii=False)) sys.exit(1)

text: !doctype html html lang="zh-CN" head meta charset="utf-8" meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" title 登录 · 运维工作台 /title link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css" script src="/login.js" defer /script /head body main p class="eyebrow" 运维编程课程 / 09 /p h1 登录运维工作台 /h1 p 使用管理员在本机创建的账户登录。没有公开注册入口。 /p section form id="login-form" label for="username" 用户名 /label input id="username" required maxlength="40" autocomplete="username" label for="password" 密码 /label input id="password" type="password" required maxlength="128" autocomplete="current-password" div class="actions" button id="login-button" type="submit" 登录 /button /div /form p id="login-message" role="status" aria-live="polite" 登录后按角色开放操作。 /p /section /main /body /html

title: login.js
text: "use strict"; document.getElementById("login-form").addEventListener("submit", function (event) { event.preventDefault(); var button = document.getElementById("login-button"); if (button.disabled) { return; } button.disabled = true; var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest(); xhr.open("POST", "/api/login"); xhr.timeout = 6000; xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json"); xhr.setRequestHeader("X-Requested-With", "ops-course"); function failed(text) { button.disabled = false; document.getElementById("password").value = ""; document.getElementById("login-message").textContent = text; } xhr.onload = function () { if (xhr.status === 200) { window.location.reload(); return; } try { failed(JSON.parse(xhr.responseText).error); } catch (error) { failed("登录响应格式异常"); } }; xhr.onerror = function () { failed("无法连接服务，请稍后重试"); }; xhr.ontimeout = function () { failed("登录超时，请重新载入页面核对登录状态"); }; xhr.send(JSON.stringify({username: document.getElementById("username").value, password: document.getElementById("password").value})); });

title: style.css
text: :root { color-scheme: light; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; color: 183147; background: f2f5f7; } { box-sizing: border-box; } body { margin: 0; } main { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 42px 24px; } h1 { font-size: 36px; margin: 8px 0; } h2 { font-size: 21px; margin-top: 0; } p { line-height: 1.65; } .eyebrow { color: 236b72; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; } .notice { background: fff4d9; border-left: 4px solid bc871e; padding: 12px 16px; } message { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid cbd8df; background: fff; } message.error { color: 992d26; border-color: cf8179; } .layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 24px; } section { background: white; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid dbe2e8; border-radius: 12px; } fieldset { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-width: 0; } label { display: block; margin: 18px 0 7px; font-weight: 600; } input, select { width: 100%; padding: 11px; font: inherit; border: 1px solid a2b5c3; border-radius: 5px; } button { font: inherit; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid 22636a; background: 22636a; color: white; cursor: pointer; } button.secondary { background: white; color: 284f68; border-color: bdcbd5; } button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; } button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid d79825; outline-offset: 3px; } .actions, .heading { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-top: 20px; } .heading { justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 0; } .heading h2 { margin: 0; } .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; } table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; text-align: left; } th, td { padding: 12px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid e1e7eb; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } th { color: 577082; font-size: 14px; } th:nth-child(3), td:nth-child(3) { white-space: nowrap; } td button { margin: 3px; padding: 7px 10px; } footer { color: 577082; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 24px; } .task-section { margin-top: 24px; } .task-section form { max-width: 480px; } pre { padding: 16px; background: f2f5f7; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } [hidden] { display: none !important; } @media (max-width: 760px) { main { padding: 24px 14px; } .layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } section { padding: 18px; } h1 { font-size: 29px; } }
